verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a billing and merchant-of-record platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature. There is no bulk export, CSV/JSON download, or offboarding path, and the only migration doc covers moving onto Polar. The API, SDKs, MCP server and open-source codebase are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented capability to export all data in open formats and leave.
